rule: For each existing native identity, compare exactly the independently verified selected candidate from V1 and V2 using the unchanged literal diagnostic_rank tuple (all witness rows feasible first, invalid orientation rows, max exact normalized violation, failed row count, scaled pose norm). Choose lexicographic minimum; exact tie selects V1. Do not search other raw states or use full-grid audit results.
preconditions: Both source candidate files, frozen method protocols and independent final source/cap/constraint review must be bound before merging. Same original caps, native targets, physical/correction/translation bounds, Shadow and scientific criteria. All selected poses remain diagnostic until the separate scientific audit.
full_audit: Exactly six coarse2mm plus existing three fine1mm repeats on resulting six poses, unchanged metric. Versions remain separate evidence; this is not independent validation/generalization.
